description: This source file contains unit tests for distributed tracing and activity propagation in an Orleans-based system. It verifies correct propagation of activity context, trace IDs, baggage, and activity ID formats across grain calls, using the .NET Activity API with W3C and Hierarchical formats.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for verifying distributed activity propagation in Orleans, including setup of activity listeners, test fixtures, and specific test cases for activity ID formats and baggage propagation.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Configures an Orleans test cluster with activity propagation enabled, including silo and client configurators.

classes.name: SiloInvokerTestSiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo to support activity propagation and in-memory storage for testing.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client to support activity propagation.

methods.name: ActivityPropagationTests
methods.description: Constructor that sets up activity listener and initializes test fixture.

methods.name: WithoutParentActivity
methods.description: Tests that Orleans creates a new activity when no parent activity exists, for both W3C and Hierarchical formats.

methods.name: WithParentActivity_W3C
methods.description: Verifies activity propagation with W3C format when a parent activity is present, including trace ID, trace state, and baggage.

methods.name: WithParentActivity_Hierarchical
methods.description: Verifies activity propagation with Hierarchical format, ensuring the grain's activity ID is a child of the parent activity and baggage is propagated.
